text:
maya: Quick flag — CI eval dashboard shows 0% coverage for quantized-model rows in the new runner table. I ran a local job and metrics exist.
conor: Hmm, saw that too on Friday. The UI drill link opens a 404 for several runs.
sasha: @conor can you paste the 404 URL? I want to see if it's a routing issue vs missing metadata.
conor: /runs/2026-03-03/qr-741 -> 404
maya: CI job logs show successful uploads: eval-bot: upload complete run_id=qr-741 size=12MB
eval-bot: run qr-741 finished successfully; artifacts: metrics.json, traces.tar.gz
jim: I'm betting the problem is the new scorecard's aggregation key change — we switched from "model_variant" to "model_key" last week; older uploads use the old key.
katie: That would explain the zero rows for quantized= true if the query filters by model_key = 'q/v1'.
sasha: Can we add a temporary backfill in the UI query to OR both keys? i.e. model_key IN (...) OR model_variant IN (...)
conor: Quick patch suggestion in the dashboard query:
```sql
SELECT * FROM runs
WHERE (model_key = 'q/v1' OR model_variant = 'q/v1')
  AND quantized = true
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
maya: I pushed a tiny change to the frontend that adds fallback; deploying to staging now.
jim: Also adding a CI check to the runner upload step to surface missing keys early. Proposed script:
```bash
python tools/validate_artifact_keys.py --required model_key,metrics.json
```
katie: Thx. Also can we make the drill link point to run_id instead of the elastic path? That will be more stable.
conor: Agree. Created a quick redirect handler at /run/{run_id} -> resolves to latest explorer path.
sasha: Staging deploy looks good, I can see quantized rows again in /staging.
maya: Nice. Can someone open a small ticket to backfill older runs to include model_key so dedicated queries work long-term? Tagging @jim
jim: On it. I'll also add a CI lint so new runner versions fail the upload if keys missing.
katie: one last ask — add a small note in the scorecard tooltip explaining what "quantized" means (link to docs).
maya: Good call — I'll add that to the tooltip copy.
conor: Thanks all. If the staging patch is green I'll roll to prod later today :thumbsup:
eval-bot: deploy staging 2026-03-06T15:22:33Z status=success
maya: prod deploy scheduled for 17:30 UTC.
conor: rolling now — monitoring dashboard for regressions.
sasha: no regressions observed after 10m.
maya: closing thread once backfill ticket is created.
jim: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-4823
maya: thanks, closing :white_check_mark:
